ticker: SpaceX Starship aces orbital return test
Delhi air quality hits hazardous levels
Iran war shapes US automotive shifts
Trump, Xi, Putin plan trilateral summit

articles.headline: SpaceX Starship Completes Historic Orbital Return
articles.brief: SpaceX's Starship successfully returned from orbit to its landing pad, marking a major milestone for reusable rocket technology and drawing praise from tech leaders globally.

articles.headline: OpenAI Disbands Robotics Unit Again
articles.brief: OpenAI has shut down its internal robotics team for the second time in six years, opting to integrate its research into broader general-purpose artificial intelligence models.

articles.headline: Italy Fines Meta Over Android Data
articles.brief: Italian regulators have slapped Meta with an $887 million fine concerning the platform's access to and handling of Android user data.

articles.headline: Tata Sons Public Listing Sparks Debate
articles.brief: Noel Tata warned that a public listing for Tata Sons could shift the traditional corporate culture away from its foundational focus on philanthropy toward profit maximization.

articles.headline: Modi's Office Summons Telecom Secretary
articles.brief: The Prime Minister's office has summoned the telecom secretary following investigations into the unauthorized use of fake court orders within official channels.

articles.headline: Trump, Xi, Putin Trilateral Summit Planned
articles.brief: Global leaders Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping are reportedly scheduled for an unprecedented trilateral meeting on the sidelines of the APEC summit to discuss geopolitical conflicts.

articles.headline: Iran War Shifts US Automotive Market
articles.brief: Ongoing conflict involving Iran is heavily reshaping the American auto sector, causing a notable surge in demand for hybrid vehicles while electric vehicle growth slows.

articles.headline: H-1B Visa Scrutiny Widens for IT Firms
articles.brief: Major Indian IT outsourcing firms including Infosys, TCS, and Wipro are facing renewed federal regulatory crackdowns regarding employment-based green card and H-1B visa programs.

articles.headline: India's Sooryavanshi Sets T20 Captaincy Record
articles.brief: Young cricketer Sooryavanshi has etched his name in the record books by becoming the youngest captain in men's T20 cricket history.

articles.headline: India Dramatically Wins U-19 Asia Cup
articles.brief: The Indian under-19 cricket squad pulled off a stunning comeback from the brink of defeat to defeat Pakistan and secure the U-19 Asia Cup title.

articles.headline: Delhi Air Quality Reaches Hazardous Levels
articles.brief: Air pollution in India's capital worsened severely, with monitoring stations recording an Air Quality Index surpassing 500, prompting urgent health advisories for residents.

articles.headline: Telangana Cracks Down on Illegal Oocyte Racket
articles.brief: The Telangana Women's Commission has issued strict legal notices to eight Assisted Reproductive Technology centers implicated in an ongoing illegal oocyte trading investigation.

articles.headline: Bahrain Issues Security Alerts Near US Navy Base
articles.brief: Bahrain's Interior Ministry issued urgent public safety alerts warning of potential security threats targeting areas surrounding the U.S. Navy's Fifth Fleet installation.

articles.headline: Zelenskyy Accuses SpaceX Over Starshield Curbs
articles.brief: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy criticized SpaceX, alleging that operational speed limits on Starshield terminals are driven by political motives rather than technical limits.

articles.headline: Odisha Braces for Third Cyclone in Weeks
articles.brief: India's eastern coastline has been placed on high alert as meteorological agencies warn that Odisha is bracing for its third cyclonic storm in three consecutive weeks.

articles.headline: Prince William and Kate Plan India Visit
articles.brief: Britain's Prince William and Kate Middleton are scheduled to visit India for the upcoming Earthshot Prize ceremony, marking their first joint overseas trip since her recovery.
